newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar down on lower demand, better supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar down on lower demand, better supply.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell in thin trade on Thursday on reduced demand and increased supplies, dealers said.
In ready delivery, sugar S 30 fell 5/10 rupees to 1,280/1,315 rupees per quintal while M 30 lost 10/20 to 1,305/1,360 rupees per quintal.
Sugar mill delivery also dropped 5 rupees to 1,230/1,240 rupees per quintal as demand petered out at higher levels, they said. This prompted fresh offerings from millers.
Sugar prices were up by 10/25 rupees per quintal on Wednesday.
